name: Fondo — Tile de Suelo de la Arena

frames.role: Tile del suelo de la arena — se repite para cubrir toda el área de juego
frames.prompt: Bird's eye top-down view (camera pointing straight down at 90 degrees) of a cartoon game arena floor tile. SEAMLESSLY TILEABLE, opaque flat background. Style matching a vibrant lush cartoon game (Brawl Stars / tropical platformer aesthetic): rich warm DARK DESATURATED OLIVE-GREEN (#2A3520 or similar deep earthy muted green), providing STRONG CONTRAST against bright orange tanks and warm-colored game elements. Very subtle organic flat texture — slightly varied soft brushstroke patches, like packed dirt/short grass seen from above, barely perceptible but gives life to the surface. No grid lines (separate overlay), no characters, no bright highlights. The surface must NOT attract attention — it is purely a high-contrast backdrop. Deep enough in tone that golden-orange tanks, yellow bullets, and green pickups all pop brightly against it. Seamlessly tileable with no visible seams. NOT dark sci-fi metallic, NOT bright, NOT distracting, NOT mid-gray neutral.
frames.negative_prompt: pixel art, dark, sci-fi, neon, grid lines, characters, objects, non-tileable edges, watermark, text, bright colors, high contrast

wormax_alternative.description: En lugar de este asset, usar un color sólido CSS en el GameScene como fondo del mundo. Sin textura, sin tile, sin asset.
wormax_alternative.implementation: this.cameras.main.setBackgroundColor('#2A3520'); // o el GameScene puede poner un Rectangle de Phaser cubriendo el área de juego

phaser_config.notes: TileSprite que cubre toda el área del mapa (variable según maxPlayers). Seamless tile.
